subject.title: fix(worker): revoke backend agents with manager grants

question: Should accepted WebVNC and Code backend agents be treated as manage-scoped bridge sessions that fail closed when the exact creating grant is no longer current, while preserving legacy hibernated agents without principal metadata?
rationale: The code direction is coherent, but it changes authorization and live WebSocket lifetime semantics for a P0 security boundary, which should be explicitly accepted by the area owner.

options.title: Approve grant-bound backend agents
options.body: Proceed with this fail-closed model after proof and changelog cleanup because it matches the documented bridge revocation boundary.

options.title: Require a narrower compatibility mode
options.body: Ask for a default-compatible path or additional upgrade tests if maintainers are not ready to fail closed for all newly accepted backend agents.

options.title: Pause the draft
options.body: Keep the PR paused until a maintainer reviews the security boundary and the contributor adds live revocation proof.

recommendation.title: Approve grant-bound backend agents
recommendation.body: Proceed with this fail-closed model after proof and changelog cleanup because it matches the documented bridge revocation boundary.
